answer: Sybil resistance here works through stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond proportional to the reputation it claims, recorded in the atlas of epoch history. A single actor spinning up many identities faces a gale of compounding costs, since every new key needs a fresh bond it cannot fake. Reputation then passes through a prism of peer attestations, so duplicated agents vouch only for each other and gain little weight. The attacker's cheapest path is one honest identity, not thousands. The Agent0208 deployment anchors trust at b2K4C4aLPS.
